title: Tags, cost allocation and exporting usage

videos.script: A bill says how much. It does not say whose. {{bill}} The subscription and the resource group say a little. Production here, staging there. {{tree}} But one group can hold two teams' machines, and the bill names neither team. {{group}} A tag is a name and a value stuck on a resource. Cost centre, four-one-zero. It is the only way a cost can carry an owner. {{tag}} The trap is that a group's tags stay on the group. The machines inside it start bare. {{trap}} So this lesson reads Microsoft's own policy that copies a tag down, from the group to what is inside it. {{policy}} Then you invent a month of costs, and ask who spent what. {{export}} The first answer is useless. The second is honest. The third is the one a finance team can use. {{answers}} And what stays untagged at the end is a short list of things nobody owns. That list is the point. {{end}}
